title: Loco Cherry Good Cherry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Wick Liquor
description:
Loco Cherry Good Cherry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquidby Wick Liquor is a sweet and tart blend of bold cherries, succulent plums and floral aniseed. The rich notes of cherries are balanced with the distinctive sweet and slightly sharp plums and rounded off beautifully with a hint of spicy aniseed.
The Wick Liquor Cherry Good Cherry range features a rich cherry base blended with vibrant fruity combinations, available in 100ml nic shot-ready shortfill bottles.
PG/VG: 30:70
Flavour Notes: Cherry, Plum, Aniseed
Made in the UK
Nic shot ready
Bottle size: 120ml (100ml of e-liquid)
We recommend to use with:
Sub-ohm vaping
